description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ModifyAclEntryStrategy class in the context of handling ACL modifications for 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It tests various scenarios like creating ACL entries, modifying existing entries, and handling invalid ACL modifications.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntryStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ModifyAclEntryStrategy class, focusing on ACL modification scenarios for 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: initTestFixture

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test by instantiating the strategy under test.

methods.description: Verifies that the ModifyAclEntryStrategy class is immutable.
